publicDeclarationReviews.name: Shao.C2.IntervalReciprocalDerivatives.reciprocalFreeDensity_mul_free
publicDeclarationReviews.fullFrozenHead:
theorem reciprocalFreeDensity_mul_free (z T y : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    reciprocalFreeDensity z T y *
      ((1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * T)) * Real.exp (-(z - y) ^ 2 / (2 * T))) = 1 := by
publicDeclarationReviews.proofReview: Split sqrt(2*pi*T) using the supplied nonnegative factor, cancel the positive square-root product, and cancel opposite exponential arguments. The literal Gaussian product is exactly one.

publicDeclarationReviews.name: Shao.C2.IntervalReciprocalDerivatives.reciprocalFreeDensity_spatial_hasDerivAt
publicDeclarationReviews.fullFrozenHead:
theorem reciprocalFreeDensity_spatial_hasDerivAt (z T y : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    HasDerivAt (reciprocalFreeDensity z T)
      ((-(z - y) / T) * reciprocalFreeDensity z T y) y := by
publicDeclarationReviews.proofReview: Actual chain rule for z-w, its square divided by constant 2*T and exp, then the constant multiplier. Complete functions are normalized extensionally; derivative is -d/T times g.

publicDeclarationReviews.name: Shao.C2.IntervalReciprocalDerivatives.reciprocalFreeDensity_time_hasDerivAt
publicDeclarationReviews.fullFrozenHead:
theorem reciprocalFreeDensity_time_hasDerivAt (z T y : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    HasDerivAt (fun S => reciprocalFreeDensity z S y)
      ((1 / (2 * T) - (z - y) ^ 2 / (2 * T ^ 2)) * reciprocalFreeDensity z T y) T := by
publicDeclarationReviews.proofReview: Pinned sqrt derivative with T nonzero; sqrt(T)/(2*T) conversion uses positive sqrt and its square. Quotient, exp and product derivatives give (1/(2*T)-d^2/(2*T^2))*g.

theorem reciprocalMixedFamily_spatial_hasDerivAt (j l : ℕ) (z T y : ℝ)

    HasDerivAt (reciprocalMixedFamily j l z T) (reciprocalMixedFamily (j + 1) l z T y) y := by

publicDeclarationReviews.name: Shao.C2.IntervalReciprocalDerivatives.reciprocalFreeDensity_spatial_iteratedDeriv

theorem reciprocalFreeDensity_spatial_iteratedDeriv (j : ℕ) (z T y : ℝ)
